gamerule.hydration_source_range.descript: The distance (in blocks) a water source block provides basic hydration to nearby farmland. Standard Minecraft uses 4, but this allows for expansive irrigation networks.
gamerule.hydration_flowing_range.descrip: The distance (in blocks) that flowing water provides hydration. Usually 0 in vanilla, this allows for dynamic irrigation using canals.
gamerule.total_trample_immunity.descript: When enabled, crops and farmland are completely immune to trample damage from players and entities. Immersive protection for delicate fields.
gamerule.growth_biodiversity_bonus.descr: When enabled, crops get a growth speed bonus when planted near different crop types. Promotes agricultural diversity.
gamerule.rain_growth_acceleration.descri: The number of extra growth stages a crop receives per random tick during rain. Simulates a natural hydration surge.
gamerule.ambient_vitality_particles.desc: When enabled, healthy growing crops emit subtle 'vitality' particles. A visual indicator of a thriving agricultural ecosystem.
gamerule.ambient_crop_rustle.description: When enabled, crops produce ambient rustling sounds when they grow or are interacted with. Enhances the organic atmosphere of the farm.
